note: Every shippable verb, one line each. The verb list and search read this and nothing else; paradigms live in content/verbs/<level>.json.

verbs.en: to be; to be located; to be situated; to denote time, day, or date
to do; to make; to say of a person, to go of an animal or device
to go; to attend (school, church regularly); to be going (to); will soon; forms a near-future tense
to want, wish, desire; to expect; to think; or; to see oneself as; to give the impression of, to seem
to come to move from one place to another that is nearer the speaker; to cum, to come, to orgasm
to take; to eat; to drink; to get; to buy
to wait for, to await; to expect; to hear
to die; to be dying; to be dying (of); to be dying
